references.name: D2MOO
policy: Use source code to recover gameplay intent, names and control-flow concepts.
Never reuse 32-bit addresses, ordinals, structure layouts or ABI assumptions in D2R.
Prove every D2R 3.2.92777 correspondence independently in the persistent workbench.

references.name: D2SSharp
references.upstreamTarget: Diablo II and D2R save formats 96-105
policy: Use the pinned implementation to verify D2S and D2I section layouts, version boundaries and bit encodings.
Keep BKVince TXT files as the sole gameplay-data and item-stat encoding source.
Preserve MIT attribution for any source code adapted rather than independently reimplemented.

references.name: eezstreet D2RL-Plugins
references.upstreamTarget: D2RLoader PluginPack 2.0.1 for Diablo II: Resurrected
policy: Treat the pinned CMake files, headers and plugin sources as the authoritative PluginPack skeleton; the upstream README may lag the implementation.
Never edit the governed clean checkout. Develop RuffnecKk integrations in the separate build-specific workbench clone.
Before designing a plugin, inventory the owning module, shared structures, configuration keys, RVAs and hook ranges against this pinned commit.
Advance the pin only through an explicit reviewed update; never silently mix evidence from different PluginPack commits.
Preserve eezstreet's MIT attribution and distinguish upstream code from independently implemented RuffnecKk features.

webReferences.name: Dimentio D2R UI Asset Browser
policy: Use the browser only to identify and preview D2R UI asset paths, dimensions and visual variants.
Treat BKVince layouts, local sprite files and the targeted installed build as the authoritative runtime sources.
Do not use this reference as evidence for a D2R build, RVA, signature, ABI or native behavior.
Do not mirror or redistribute the remote asset collection without separately establishing provenance and permission.

webReferences.name: Guide to Events, Itemevents and Auraevents
webReferences.author: Cypress
webReferences.upstreamTarget: Diablo II Legacy softcoded event, itemevent and auraevent behavior
scope: events.txt trigger semantics and edge cases
event and function compatibility test matrices
threadNotes: The guide marks several observations and unanswered questions as uncertain; preserve that status until reproduced.

Necrolis states in a follow-up that item events and aura events use the same underlying table, while Cypress notes that their softcoded inputs remain distinct and asks whether they can be crossed; the thread does not resolve that follow-up question.
webReferences.provenance: community-authored empirical guide with credited prior sources
policy: Use the guide as a semantic inventory and as candidate test cases for event triggers, ItemStatCost itemevent functions and skills auraevent functions.
Distinguish confirmed observations from the author's brace-marked hypotheses, untested cases and open questions.
Reproduce relevant behavior against BKVince data and the targeted installed D2R build before relying on it for an implementation.
Do not use this legacy guide as evidence for a D2R build, RVA, signature, structure layout, ABI or unchanged native behavior.
Cite Cypress and the Phrozen Keep thread when derived behavior or test matrices materially rely on this guide; retain the guide's upstream credits where applicable.
